desc: Build the adjacency list and generate an iterative parent/order traversal.
Process vertices in reverse order, maintaining at most one unfinished path length per subtree.
Apply transitions for zero, one, or two active child paths; reject invalid lengths or more than two active paths.
Handle \(K=1\) correctly and accept only when the root has no unfinished path.
Output the solution in the required Python code delimiters.
